title: Special Topics in Latin Literature; PLINY THE ELDER
description: This seminar will be an introduction to Roman civilization through an unusual lens: the genre of ancient encyclopedias. Instead of following achronological history, we will see the ancient world as the Romans explained it to themselves-through their accounts of geography, technology, social life, economy, professions, and art. While doing so, students will develop both their command of Latin and their academic writing skills.
